info.name: Apify Actors — Make No Mistakes
info.description: Run-sync-get-dataset-items calls for the two Make No Mistakes Apify Actors: US Building Permits Scraper and Multi-ATS Job Board API. Each request returns dataset items directly in the HTTP response body (no separate dataset fetch or polling). Set the `apify_token` collection variable to your own Apify API token (Console -> Settings -> API & Integrations) before sending. Example bodies were verified live against both actors with maxItems:5.

request.description: Minimal-cost smoke test: 1 city, 7 days back, capped at 5 items. Cost: $0.02 run start + $0.008/permit -> $0.06 for this exact call. Swap `cities` to any of the 16 supported keys (see the actor README) and raise `maxItems` for a real pull. Full input fields: cities, daysBack, startDate, endDate, maxItems, permitTypes, includeAdministrative, contractorPhoneOnly, onlyNewSinceLastRun, deltaStateName.

Minimal-cost smoke test: 3 well-known companies, capped at 5 items. Verified live 2026-09-04 (HTTP 201, 5 items returned). Cost: $0.005 run start + $0.004/job -> $0.025 for this exact call. Set `discoverOnly: true` instead of `maxItems` for a near-free ATS lookup ("which platform is this company on") at $0.001/company. Full input fields: companies, discoverOnly, platforms, maxItems, postedWithinDays, titleIncludes, location, remoteOnly, includeDescription.
